	<meta charset="utf-8">

<title>[TITLE]</title>
<style type="text/css">
#header {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0px;
  left: 0px;
  height: 64px;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
}

#Play {
  position: relative;
  vertical-align:middle;
  text-align:center;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

#notes {
  border-radius: 25px;
  position: relative;
  top: 0px;
  right: 0px;
  width: 90%;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  height: 64px;
  background-color: blue;
  color: white;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;
  font-style: italic;
  display:none;
  padding: 10px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 5px blue;
  padding:auto;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

#dialog {
transform-origin: top left;
transform: scaleX(0);
transition: 1s ease;
border-radius: 10px;
position: fixed;
bottom: 10px;
left: 10px;
width: 256px;
height: 64px;
background-color: orange;
color: white;
font-size: 16px;
font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;
padding: 10px;
box-shadow: 2px 2px 5px orange;
vertical-align: middle;
text-align: center;
z-index: 10000;
}

#dialog a {
	color: white;
	font-weight: bold;
}


 /* The Modal (background) */
.modal {
  display: none; /* Hidden by default */
  position: fixed; /* Stay in place */
  z-index: 1; /* Sit on top */
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%; /* Full width */
  height: 100%; /* Full height */
  overflow: auto; /* Enable scroll if needed */
  background-color: rgb(0,0,0); /* Fallback color */
  background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); /* Black w/ opacity */
}

/* Modal Content/Box */
.modal-content {
  background-color: #fefefe;
  margin: 15% auto; /* 15% from the top and centered */
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid #888;
  width: 80%; /* Could be more or less, depending on screen size */
}

/* The Close Button */
.close {
  color: #aaa;
  float: right;
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.close:hover,
.close:focus {
  color: black;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
} 

</style>
<script type="text/javascript">
// Configuration
var langueorigine = "@@LANGUEORIGINE@@";
var languetraduction = "@@LANGUETRADUCTION@@";
var nslides = @@NBSLIDES@@;
var title = "@@TITRE@@";
var filename = "@@FILENAME@@";

var slidesnotes = @@SLIDESNOTES@@;
var Timages = @@IMAGES@@;
var aspectratio = eval("@@ASPECTRATIO@@");
var keepaspectratio = eval("@@KEEPASPECTRATIO@@" != "N");


// --------- Fin Configuration





document.title = title;
var languetraduction_0 = languetraduction;
var current = 0;
var currenttxt = 0;
var move = false;

function formate(n) {
  var res = n;
  var puiss=Math.pow(10,nbzerosignificatif-1);
  while (n<puiss) {
    puiss/=10;
    res="0"+res;
  }
  return res;
};

function update() {
  //document.getElementById('slidenum').innerHTML = current;
  //document.getElementById('infos').innerHTML = builtin_voice.lang+" ("+builtin_voice.name+")";
  //if (current>0) EcouterTexte(TslidesNotes,0);
  document.getElementById('slidesprogress').value=currenttxt*100/TslidesNotes.length;
}

function Init() {
document.getElementById('slidesprogress').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  var w=document.getElementById('slidesprogress').offsetWidth;
  var x=e.x-document.getElementById('slidesprogress').offsetLeft;
  document.getElementById('slidesprogress').value = 100*x/w;
  currenttxt = Math.floor(TslidesNotes.length*x/w);
  move=true;
  window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  //alert(currenttxt+'   '+TslideNumber[currenttxt]);
});
document.getElementById('slide').src=Timages[0];
}

function forward() {
  if (current<nslides) current++;
//  document.getElementById('slide').src=filename+formate(current)+extension;
//  document.getElementById('slide').src=filename+formate(TslideNumber[currenttxt]+1)+extension;
	document.getElementById('slide').src=Timages[current-1];
  //console.log('Forward to slide '+(current-1));
  update();
}

function backward() {
  if (current>1) current--;
//  document.getElementById('slide').src=filename+formate(current)+extension;
	document.getElementById('slide').src=Timages[current-1];
	//console.log('Backward to slide '+(current-1));
    update();
}

var flagresource=-1;

function HideResource(flag) {
  //console.log("HideResource with flag="+flag+" and flagresource="+flagresource);
	//document.getElementById('dialog').style.transform='scaleX(0)';
	if (flag == flagresource) {
		document.getElementById('dialog').style.transform='scaleX(0)';
	}

}

function ShowResource(resource) {
  resource[1]=resource[1].replaceAll(" :",":");
	document.getElementById('dialog').innerHTML = 'Have a look on this resource<br/><a href="'+resource[1]+'">'+resource[0]+'</a>';
	document.getElementById('dialog').style.transform='scaleX(1)';
	flagresource++;
	setTimeout("HideResource("+flagresource+");",20000);
}



function EcouterTexte(Tch, c) {
  if (move) {
    move = false;
    c = currenttxt;
    document.getElementById('slide').src=Timages[TslideNumber[c]];
		console.log('Jumping to slide '+TslideNumber[c]);
		current=TslideNumber[c]+1;

  }
  update();
  currenttxt = c;
  if (c < Tch.length) {
    var s = Tch[c];
    if (s.indexOf("[forward]") >= 0) {
      console.log("AVANCER");
      forward();
      s = s.replace("[forward]", "");
    }
    if (s.indexOf("[backward]") >= 0) {
      console.log("RECULER");
      backward();
      s = s.replace("[backward]", "");
    }
		if (s.indexOf("[pause]") >= 0) {
      console.log("PAUSE");
      alert('Pause\nPress OK to resume');
      
      //myalert('Pause<br/>Press OK to resume');

      s = s.replace("[pause]", "");
    }
		if (s.indexOf("[resource ") >= 0) {
		  var resource = s.replace("[resource ","").replace("]","").split("|");
			if (resource.length > 0) {
				if (resource.length <2) resource[1]=resource[0];
      	console.log("Resource : "+resource[0]+' à '+resource[1]);
      	ShowResource(resource);
				}
				s = "";
    }
    // console.log(s);
    if (true) { //(langueorigine.substr(0,2) == languetraduction.substr(0,2)) {
      Affiche(s);
      ParleThen(s, function() {
        EcouterTexte(Tch, c + 1);
      });
    } else {
      Translate(s, languetraduction, langueorigine, function() {
        EcouterTexte(Tch, c + 1);
      });
    }
  }
}

function Affiche(txt) {
    document.getElementById("notes").innerHTML = txt;
}

function Translate(ch, l, linput, f) {
  l = l.substr(0,2);
  linput = linput.substr(0,2);
  // alert("traduction de "+ch+"\n\n"+linput+" --> "+l);
  var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
  xhr.open("POST", "../Translate.php?texte=" + ch + "&lang=" + l + "&langinput=" + linput + "&ROOMID=" + filename + "&lineid=" + currenttxt, true);

  xhr.onreadystatechange = function() { // Call a function when the state changes.
    if (this.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE && this.status === 200) {
      // console.log(this.responseText);
      var response = JSON.parse(this.responseText);
      if ((! response["error"]) && response["data"]["translations"]) {
        Affiche(response["data"]["translations"][0]["translatedText"]);
        ParleThen(response["data"]["translations"][0]["translatedText"],f);
      } else {
        Affiche("---- Translation ERROR ----")
      }

    }
  };
  xhr.send();
}

var Tvoices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
var current_voice = 0;
var builtin_voice = Tvoices[current_voice];
if (builtin_voice) languetraduction = builtin_voice.lang.replace("_","-");


function loadVoicesWhenAvailable() {
         Tvoices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();

         if (Tvoices.length !== 0) {
                LoadVoices();
            }
            else {
                setTimeout(function () { loadVoicesWhenAvailable(); }, 10)
            }
    }

function LoadVoices() {
  Tvoices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
	/*if (Tvoices.length == 0) {
				 loadVoicesWhenAvailable();
	}*/
  current_voice = 0;
  builtin_voice = Tvoices[current_voice];
  for(var i=0; i<Tvoices.length; i++)
    if (Tvoices[i].lang.substr(0,2) == languetraduction_0.substr(0,2) && Tvoices[i].lang.substr(3,2) == languetraduction_0.substr(3,2)) current_voice = i;
  builtin_voice = Tvoices[current_voice];
  languetraduction = builtin_voice.lang.replace("_","-");
  PopulateVoicesIn();
};

var Tvoices;
var current_voice = 0;
var builtin_voice = null;

function PopulateVoicesIn() {
  var allvoices = "";
  var select = document.getElementById('classroomlanguage');
  nopt = 0;
  for(var i=0; i<Tvoices.length; i++) {
    if (allvoices.indexOf('|'+Tvoices[i].lang+'_'+Tvoices[i].name+'|')<0) {//(voices[i].localService) {
      var lang=Tvoices[i].lang; //.substr(0,5);
        var opt=document.createElement("option");
        opt.value=i;
        opt.innerHTML=lang+" ("+Tvoices[i].name+")";
        if (lang == languetraduction) opt.selected = true;
        select.appendChild(opt);
        allvoices+='|'+Tvoices[i].lang+'_'+Tvoices[i].name+'|';
      }
  }
}


function ParleThen(txt, f) {
  if (paused) f=function () {};
  if (txt.length>0) {
		if (document.getElementById('classroomlanguage').value.indexOf('no voice')<0) {
			//console.log("Speak with voice "+builtin_voice)
  		var discours = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(txt);
  		discours.voice = builtin_voice;
			discours.lang = builtin_voice.lang.replace('_','-')
  		window.speechSynthesis.speak(discours);
  		discours.onend = f;
		} else {
			//console.log('Speak with no voice');
			var txtlength=Math.max(20,txt.length);
			txtlength=Math.min(100,txtlength);
			setTimeout(f,50*txt.length);
		}
  } else setTimeout(f,100);
}

//window.onclick = forward;
//window.ondblclick = backward;

function updateSlideNotes(langvoice) {
// Possible languages (notes translated)
var posslang=[];
for(var lang in slidesnotes) posslang[lang.substr(0,2)] = lang;
var lang = posslang[langvoice.substr(0,2)];
	TslidesNotes=[];
 	TslideNumber=[];
 	numslide=0;
	for(var i=0; i<slidesnotes[lang].length; i++) {
  	TslidesNotes.push('[forward]');
  	TslideNumber.push(numslide);
  	var notes=slidesnotes[lang][i].Notes;
  	for(var j=0; j<notes.length; j++) {
    	if (notes[j].indexOf("[forward]")>=0) numslide++;
    	TslidesNotes.push(notes[j]);
    	TslideNumber.push(numslide);
  	}
  	numslide++;
		}
}

var lang = 0;
for(lang in slidesnotes) break;
var TslidesNotes=[];
var TslideNumber=[];
var numslide=0;
for(var i=0; i<slidesnotes[lang].length; i++) {
  TslidesNotes.push('[forward]');
  TslideNumber.push(numslide);
  var notes=slidesnotes[lang][i].Notes;
  for(var j=0; j<notes.length; j++) {
    if (notes[j].indexOf("[forward]")>=0) numslide++;
    TslidesNotes.push(notes[j]);
    TslideNumber.push(numslide);
  }
  numslide++;
}
//console.log('TslideNumber='+TslideNumber);


function resizeslides() {
  var wx = window.innerWidth;
  var wy = window.innerHeight;
  var img = document.getElementById('slide');
  var imgmaxw = wx;
  var imgmaxh = (wy - 64 - 50);
  if (keepaspectratio) {
    if (imgmaxw/imgmaxh > aspectratio) {
      imgmaxw = imgmaxh*aspectratio;
    } else {
      imgmaxh = imgmaxw/aspectratio;
    }
  }
  img.style.width = imgmaxw+"px";
  img.style.height = imgmaxh+"px";
}


var paused=true;
var started=false;
function play() {
  if (!started) {
    started=true;
    document.getElementById('Play').style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById('notes').style.display = "flex";
    document.getElementById('bar').style.display = "block";
  }
  if (paused) {
    document.getElementById('button1').value = '||';
      paused = !paused;
      //if (window.speechSynthesis.paused) window.speechSynthesis.resume();
      EcouterTexte(TslidesNotes,currenttxt);
  } else {
//    document.getElementById('Play').style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById('button1').value = '>';
    //if (window.speechSynthesis.pending) window.speechSynthesis.pause();
    paused = !paused;
  }
}

function setLanguage(i) {
	builtin_voice=Tvoices[0];
	var found=false;
	for(var k=0; k<Tvoices.length; k++) {
		if ((Tvoices[k].lang.replace("_","-")+" ("+Tvoices[k].name+")") == i) {builtin_voice=Tvoices[k]; found=true;}
	}
  languetraduction = builtin_voice.lang.replace("_","-");
	if (!found) {buitin_voice=null;}
}

window.onresize = resizeslides;

//alert(TslidesNotes);

	var i=0;

        var opt=document.createElement("option");
        opt.value=lang;
				i++;
        opt.innerHTML=lang;
        if (lang == languetraduction) opt.selected = true;
        select.appendChild(opt);

}

function PopulateVoicesIn() {
	// Possible languages (notes translated)
	var posslang=[];
	for(var lang in slidesnotes) posslang[lang.substr(0,2)] = lang;

  var seenlang=[];
  var allvoices = "";
  var select = document.getElementById('classroomlanguage');
  nopt = 0;
  for(var i=0; i<Tvoices.length; i++) {
    if (allvoices.indexOf('|'+Tvoices[i].lang+'_'+Tvoices[i].name+'|')<0) {
      var lang=Tvoices[i].lang.replace("_","-"); //.substr(0,5);
        var opt=document.createElement("option");
        opt.value=lang+" ("+Tvoices[i].name+")";
        opt.innerHTML=lang+" ("+Tvoices[i].name+")";
        if (lang.toLowerCase() == languetraduction.toLowerCase()) opt.selected = true;
				if (! posslang[lang.substr(0,2)]) opt.disabled = true; else select.appendChild(opt);
        if (posslang[lang.substr(0,2)]) seenlang[lang.substr(0,2)] = true;
        allvoices+='|'+Tvoices[i].lang.replace("_","-")+'_'+Tvoices[i].name+'|';
      }
    }
  for(var lang in slidesnotes) {
    if (! seenlang[lang.substr(0,2)]) {
        var opt=document.createElement("option");
        opt.value=lang+" (no voice)";
        opt.innerHTML=lang+" (no voice)";
       select.appendChild(opt);
    }
  }
}


</script>
</head>
<body onload="resizeslides(); loadVoicesWhenAvailable(); Init();">
  <div id="header">
    <div id="bar" style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; width:80%; display:none;">
    <input type="button" id="button1" onclick="play();" value="||" style="display:none;"/>

	<button type="button" id="button2" onclick="window.location.reload();" style="background-color:transparent; border-color:transparent;">
      <img src=" data:image/png;base64," title="Restart" height="32"/>
    </button>

	<button type="button" id="button3" onclick="window.speechSynthesis.pause();" style="background-color:transparent; border-color:transparent;">
      <img src=" data:image/png;base64," title="Pause" height="32"/>
    </button>

	<button type="button" id="button4" onclick="window.speechSynthesis.resume();" style="background-color:transparent; border-color:transparent;">
      <img src=" data:image/png;base64," title="Play" height="32"/>
    </button>

    <progress id="slidesprogress" max="100" value="0" style="margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; height: 30px; width:60%;"> 0% </progress>
    </div>
    <div id="Play" >
        1) Choose your language
        <br/>
				<select id="classroomlanguage" onchange="setLanguage(this.value); updateSlideNotes(this.value);"></select>
         <br/>
        <br/>

        2) Launch the presentation<br/>
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," height="48" onclick="play();"/>
    </div>
    <div id="notes"></div>
  <div>
  <div id="content" style="text-align:center;">
    <img src="" id="slide" style="width:100%; height: 100%"></img>
  </div>
	<div id="FS" onclick="if (!document.fullscreenElement) {  document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();} else {document.exitFullscreen();}" style="position: fixed; top:0px; right: 0px; font-size: 12px;" title="Toggle fullscreen mode"><img src=" data:image/png;base64," style="width:50px; height: 50px"></div>
  <div id="dialog">OK</div>

  <div class="modal-content">
    <span class="close">&times;</span>
    <p id="pausecontent">Pause<br/>Press OK to resume</p>
  </div>-->

</div>
</body>
